basics.name: Samyak Mukherjee
basics.label: AI Content Strategist | API Documentation | RAG, MCP, Agent | Agile | Doc-as-Code | GitHub | Bitbucket | LLMs | GenAI | Prompt Engineering | Aviation | Rail | Software & Hardware Documentation

summary: Technical Writer with expertise in API documentation, SaaS, and AI-driven content strategies. Skilled in creating clear, concise, and user-focused documentation across software, hardware, aviation, and rail domains. Certified in product, process, and technical documentation. Completed Lean Six Sigma Green Belt Certification through Experian's EmPower programme, with a focus on process improvement, data analysis, and operational efficiency. Experienced in Agile and SAFe frameworks, with hands-on exposure to Doc-as-Code environments. Tools: Jira, Confluence, FrameMaker, MadCap Flare, Bitbucket, GitHub, Oxygen XML Author, MS Visio. Core strengths: API documentation and developer portals, Single-sourcing and topic-based authoring, Structured documentation using XML and DITA, Context-sensitive help and modular content design, AI integration in documentation workflows using LLMs, GenAI, and prompt engineering. Previously served as onsite coordinator in Kingston, Canada, supporting global documentation initiatives and cross-functional teams.
